content:
It's Monday morning. Duc is showing his friend at work, Hanh, some photos of his trip to Sapa.

Duc says, "This is the first day. We were walking through a small village when we took this photo."
"Who is the man in the red jacket?"
"That's my friend Bao. He was talking to a little girl. She was selling bags."
Hanh looks at the next photo. "Wow, the mountains are beautiful! What were you doing here?"
"We were climbing Fansipan. It was very cold, and the clouds were all around us."
"And this one? Why is everybody laughing?"
"We were having dinner at a homestay. The owner was cooking for us, and his son was playing music."
"Were you tired after the trip?"
"Yes, very. On the last day, we were walking in the rice fields when it started to rain. We didn't have an umbrella!"
Hanh laughs. "I want to go to Sapa too."

questions.promptVi: Câu chuyện nói về điều gì?
options: Duc shows Hanh photos of his trip to Sapa.
Hanh wants to live in Sapa.
Duc buys bags from a little girl.

Why is everybody laughing in the dinner photo?

options: They were having dinner, and the owner's son was playing music.

questions.prompt: Trong câu này, "all around us" nghĩa là gì?
questions.quote: It was very cold, and the clouds were all around us."
questions.explanationVi: All around us = bao quanh chúng tôi: mây ở khắp xung quanh.

grammarNote.title: Quá khứ tiếp diễn (when, while)
grammarNote.bodyVi: Khi xem ảnh và kể lúc đó ai đang làm gì, dùng was / were + V-ing: He was talking to a little girl, She was selling bags, We were climbing Fansipan. Việc đang diễn ra thì một việc ngắn xảy ra dùng when + quá khứ đơn: We were walking through a small village when we took this photo. Hỏi: What were you doing here?
examples: We were walking through a small village when we took this photo."
He was talking to a little girl.

annotate.writingPrompt: Choose a photo from a trip. Write about it: where were you, and what were you and other people doing?
sentenceTranslations: Hôm nay là sáng thứ Hai.
Đức đang cho bạn cùng công ty là Hạnh xem ảnh chuyến đi Sa Pa.
Đức nói: "Đây là ngày đầu tiên.
Bọn mình đang đi qua một ngôi làng nhỏ thì chụp ảnh này."
"Anh mặc áo khoác đỏ là ai thế?"
Lúc đó cậu ấy đang nói chuyện với một cô bé.
Ở đây các cậu đang làm gì?"
Trời rất lạnh, và mây bao quanh bọn mình."
"Bọn mình đang ăn tối ở một homestay.
Ông chủ nấu ăn cho bọn mình, còn con trai ông thì chơi nhạc."
Hôm cuối, bọn mình đang đi bộ trên ruộng lúa thì trời đổ mưa.

practice.objectiveVi: Bạn có thể kể lại ảnh chuyến đi: lúc đó mình và mọi người đang làm gì, bằng was / were + V-ing và when.

turns.text: Duc, is this your photo from Sapa?
turns.meaningVi: Đức ơi, đây là ảnh cậu chụp ở Sa Pa à?

turns.text: Yes. We were walking in the mountains.
turns.meaningVi: Ừ. Lúc đó bọn mình đang đi bộ trên núi.

turns.text: It was cold, and it was raining a little.
turns.meaningVi: Trời lạnh, và mưa lất phất.
Người phụ nữ kia là ai?

turns.text: She was the owner of our homestay. She was cooking for us.
turns.meaningVi: Cô ấy là chủ homestay. Lúc đó cô ấy đang nấu ăn cho bọn mình.

turns.text: And why were you all laughing here?
turns.meaningVi: Còn ở ảnh này sao mọi người đều cười?

turns.text: Bao was dancing when he fell on the floor!
turns.meaningVi: Bảo đang nhảy thì ngã ra sàn!
Ôi! Cậu ấy có sao không?

turns.text: Yes, he was fine. He was laughing too.
turns.meaningVi: Không sao. Cậu ấy cũng cười mà.

practice.grammarTipVi: Hỏi về ảnh: Why were you all laughing? What was the weather like? Kể: She was cooking for us. Bao was dancing when he fell on the floor.

grammarStep.questionVi: Vì sao bài viết "He was talking" nhưng "We were climbing"?
options: Vì He đi với was, We đi với were.
Vì câu thứ hai là câu hỏi.
grammarStep.explanationVi: I / He / She / It + was; We / You / They + were.
grammarStep.whenVi: Dùng quá khứ tiếp diễn để tả cảnh trong một bức ảnh hay một lúc trong quá khứ: ai đang làm gì.

table.subject: I / He / She / It
table.form: He was talking to a little girl.

table.subject: Câu hỏi
table.negative: Were you tired? — Yes, we were.

table.subject: when + quá khứ đơn
table.form: We were walking when it started to rain.

grammarStep.noteVi: Động từ một âm tiết tận cùng bằng một nguyên âm + một phụ âm thì gấp đôi phụ âm: run → running, sit → sitting, swim → swimming.

exercises.promptVi: Sắp xếp các từ thành câu đúng.

readAloud.text: He was talking to a little girl.
readAloud.tipVi: Talking /ˈtɔːkɪŋ/ không đọc âm l; girl /ɡɜːl/ có âm /ɜː/.
Were you nối liền /wɜːju/; câu hỏi Yes/No lên giọng ở cuối.

writingHelp.grammarLabelVi: Có ít nhất 1 câu quá khứ tiếp diễn (was / were + V-ing)
outlineVi: Ảnh chụp ở đâu, khi nào.
Trong ảnh ai đang làm gì (was / were + V-ing).
Có chuyện gì xảy ra (when + quá khứ đơn).
writingHelp.modelAnswer: This is a photo from my trip to Ha Long last year. We were sitting on a boat, and the sun was shining. My father was taking photos of the islands, and my little brother was eating ice cream. My mother wasn't looking at the sea. She was sleeping! We were laughing when my uncle took this photo.
